findings.title: Disabled and shadow modes cannot produce the receipt approval requires
Order claims can bypass the required order evidence
Aggregate test budget omits separately listed cases
A complete review with findings is reported as missing
Freshness check misses draft-only PR state changes

inconclusive.missing: A proven reachable pinned executable route supplying trusted enforced authority to the review producer and receipt-required approval consumer. The decisive bundled entry and dispatch reads were unavailable (git-budget).

candidates.reason: “Disabled and shadow modes cannot produce the receipt approval requires” is confirmed for the trusted-authority rollback route. The observer requires a receipt even for a supplied disabled/shadow authority, while producer composition and the anchored guard prevent those modes from supplying the publication needed to render it. Earlier enforced receipts cannot substitute because the consumer binds mode, generation and policy digest. When preceding gates pass, approval therefore remains pending with bugbot-missing and cannot submit approval. This does not imply that the ordinary no-authority legacy route is blocked; that route can use status-card evidence.

Confirmed on the lifecycle shadow-verifier route. A conclusive refuted response can use 'Preparation executes earlier than delivery.' as its premise and reason, supply valid ordinary citations, and set order=[]. Neither regex check recognizes that sequence wording. The schema and imported closure policy do not supply the missing requirement. With other validation satisfied and no required/material dependencies, closureIssues remains empty and the answer becomes a verdict without evidence for both operations and their ordering mechanism. This establishes a source-level acceptance bypass, not an observed live-model occurrence.

The hypothesis survives refutation: line 3921 derives its aggregate solely as 30 + 6 = 36, while the amendment requires adding a separately enumerated 13-case inventory and retaining the owner's cases. Those sets require 49 cases, not the stated 36-case aggregate. This confirms a specification-budget omission, not an executed-test shortfall or qualification bypass; the separately stated case obligations still apply.

The source establishes a conditional mismatch at the anchor, but not the claimed reachable runtime effect. With trusted enforced authority, a complete review can carry findings and a neutral check; the receipt-required consumer rejects that check and reports missing evidence. However, the ordinary source entry supplies no authority, so approval uses legacy status-card evidence instead. Enforced configuration alone cannot enable the affected route. The shipped action executes a bundle whose decisive entry and dispatch reads were unavailable (git-budget), preventing confirmation of authority admission or a conclusive runtime refutation.
candidates.missing: A proven reachable pinned executable route supplying trusted enforced authority to the review producer and receipt-required approval consumer. The decisive bundled entry and dispatch reads were unavailable (git-budget).

candidates.reason: The hypothesis “Freshness check misses draft-only PR state changes” is confirmed for non-framed reviews at src/application/usecases/steps/commit/bugbot/bugbot_review_freshness.ts:37–40. If a ready PR becomes draft after preflight while its compared identity fields remain unchanged, the anchored enforced-mode check returns false. The application can consequently reach publication despite reviewDrafts=false, and its post-publication check also misses the transition. Ordinary non-framed checks likewise miss it. The initial live draft guard protects PRs already draft at preflight, and framed-source reviews detect draft changes; neither defeats this scoped race.
